parameters.content:
## Torah Get Page Translations

**Endpoint:** GET /webhook/torah-get-page-translations

**Query Parameters:**
- `traite`: Nom du traité (ex: Berakhot)
- `page`: Numéro de page (ex: 2a)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "traite": "Berakhot",
  "page": "2a",
  "reference": "Berakhot 2a",
  "segments_count": 14,
  "translated_count": 14,
  "segments": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "hebrew_text": "מֵאֵימָתַי קוֹרִין...",
      "translation": {
        "translated_text": "À partir de quand lit-on...",
        "provider": "claude+openai",
        "model": "claude-sonnet-4+gpt-4o"
      },
      "has_translation": true
    }
  ]
}
```

parameters.url: ={{ $env.API_URL }}/api/talmud/page/{{ encodeURIComponent($json.traite) }}/{{ encodeURIComponent($json.page) }}/segments{{ (() => { let params = []; if ($json.includeTranslations) { params.push('include_translations=true'); params.push('target_language=' + $json.targetLanguage); } if ($json.corpus) { params.push('corpus=' + encodeURIComponent($json.corpus)); } return params.length > 0 ? '?' + params.join('&') : ''; })() }}
